### 1. Request, authority, simulator
Dale Strehlow (self, uninsured) asks to "pay what Riverbend needs from you before the surgery, today" on his cataract surgery package, paying himself by card. Identity: name + phone 9205550512 → `find_customers` returns customer 65aa667e…, DOB 1968-03-14, MRN RB55204817 (both stated by persona when asked). Simulator only conveys need, answers if asked (FAP letter; ER Oct 3 / call Oct 4), executes a user tool handed over for "exactly the amount the agent gave you", accepts a fee explanation ("tell them to go ahead"). It never supplies a figure.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at frozen time
Act now. Estimate 13e359ed… type "Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery", status issued, scheduled_service_date 2026-11-05. Pre-service balance "is paid no later than the type's balance-due days before the scheduled service date and may be paid earlier" (surgery pre-service payment card); balance-due days 7 (deposit schedule) → by 2026-10-29; today 2026-10-20 → in time. Initial deposit is paid "on request" (initial-deposit payment card). No exempting award: case 2ef340fe… tier "Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL)", hardship_liability_cap_usd 0.0 — not a Presumptive/Full Charity Care tier, not "a hardship liability cap above zero with no cap left" (initial-deposit Clause 2 table; pre-service §2; late-change Term 3).

### 3. Object and correlation
Single estimate 13e359ed…, current version 2 (issued 2026-10-05). V2 lines: facility 66984 2480.00, professional 66984 900.00, facility V2787 1150.00, co-provider anesthesia 00142 680.00. Deposit activity: no collections (deposit_held_usd 0.0). Procedure slot: appointment 62fd8a2e… "Outpatient Procedure Appointment", cancelled_by PATIENT, cancelled_date 2026-10-04, appointment_date 2026-10-08 (the only patient-cancelled one). ED account e519a1d9…: 0450 line service_date 2026-10-03, gross charges 1878.00, no charge credits (adjustments are UNINSURED_DISCOUNT and FAP_CHARITY_ADJUSTMENT only). Missed-appointment fees: NO_SHOW_FEE assessed 2026-05-19 (waived), NO_SHOW_FEE assessed 2025-03-11 (waived). Excluded: anesthesia line and V2787 from the package price; 2025-03-11 fee (outside 12 whole months); booked appointment 00fbd916… (not cancelled).

### 4. Figures (every tiered rule the visible docs state)
Surgical package price = 2480.00 + 900.00 = **3380.00** (matches price list 66984).

**A. Initial deposit** (surgery initial-deposit computation Clauses 3–4; package % 50 from deposit schedule):
- Award base (FAP award base doc): award 2025-10-09..2027-04-14 covers 2026-11-05; tier discount 40 (above 0, below 100) → figured on 3380.00 × 0.60 = 2028.00. Evidence: find_assistance_cases variant_name "Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL)", status approved. [cross-product: the tier's discount percentage is read from the tier name; the Financial Assistance Program KB is not yet published — conditional.]
- Days to surgery (days-to-surgery doc): 2026-10-20→2026-11-05 = 16 → 8–20 → percentage set at 75 (takes the place of the package's 50).
- Late initial deposit points: scheduling_date 2026-09-14 → today 36 days → 30–59 → +5.
- Missed-appointment points: one fee (2026-05-19) inside 12 whole months, waived still counts → +5.
- Booking history points: versions carrying the facility 66984 line = v1, v2 → exactly 2 → +5.
- Percentage = 75 + 15 = 90 (≤100). Deposit = 2028.00 × 0.90 = **1825.20**.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): 3380.00 × 50% = **1690.00** — differs.

**B. Late-change fee** (late-change computation Terms 2–5): late patient move holds — first patient-cancelled procedure slot cancelled 2026-10-04, 4 days before slot 2026-10-08 (< 7 full-refund days), estimate not cancelled, current v2 issued 2026-10-05 ≥ change date with date 2026-11-05 ≠ slot, no 0120/0762 line dated 2026-10-04. No retained fee entry yet.
- Fee basis scale: price 3380.00 in [2500, 5000) → larger of 150.00 and 5% × 3380 = 169.00 → basis **169.00**.
- FAP share: covering award, discount 40 → 0.60.
- ER share: latest 0450 dated 2026-10-03 = day before change date; account net charges 1878.00 > 0 → 0.5.
- Notice share: 2026-10-04→2026-10-08 = 4 notice days → 0.5.
- Postponement share: 2026-10-08→2026-11-05 = 28 days → 15–35 → 0.75.
- Fee = 169.00 × 0.60 × 0.5 × 0.5 × 0.75 = 19.0125 → **19.01** (≤ deposits held). Drawn on the most recent collection that can cover it = the initial-deposit collection just created.
- Fall-back: 150.00 (no factor) — differs.

**C. Pre-service balance** (pre-service computation §3–§4):
- Price owed before surgery (FAP price doc): 3380.00 × 0.60 = 2028.00.
- Deposits held after A and B: 1825.20 − 19.01 = 1806.19. Rest = 221.81.
- Implant clause: V2787 facility line on v2 → whole implant total +1150.00.
- Early-payment credit: 16 days to surgery → 14–20 → 1% × 3380.00 = −33.80.
- Pay-in-full credit: latest initial deposit collection posted today → 0 days → 1.5% × 3380.00 = −50.70.
- Balance = 221.81 + 1150.00 − 33.80 − 50.70 = **1287.31** (> 0, owed).
- Fall-back (no factor anywhere): 3380.00 − (1690.00 − 150.00) = 1840.00; with the factored deposits but no balance factor: 3380.00 − 1806.19 = 1573.81 — both differ.

Factor findability from record words: "Riverbend 40% Charity Discount" / approved case → docs titled "Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) Awards and the …" (3 docs); revenue_code 0450 / "Emergency Department Visit Account" → "Emergency Room Charges and the Late-Change Fee…" (names revenue code 0450 and Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)); appointment cancelled_by PATIENT, "Outpatient Procedure Appointment" → notice and postponement share docs (name Appointment Scheduling and that appointment type); visit_fee_assessed NO_SHOW_FEE → missed-appointment doc (names Appointment Scheduling, no-show); service_code V2787 → implant doc; estimate scheduling_date / versions / scheduled_service_date / variant_name → the late-payment, booking-history, days-to-surgery, fee-basis-scale, early-payment and pay-in-full docs, all titled with the estimate type name. No computation document named any factor.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
Root P0 = pre-service balance payment (customer's own write; surgery pre-service payment card).
- Hop P0←P1 (state-derived): surgery pre-service computation §5 "The pre-service balance is fixed only after the booking carries its initial deposit collection." + find_estimate_transactions shows no collection. The write that adds an "initial deposit collection": initial-deposit payment card ("a new deposit collection … deposit_stage is INITIAL_DEPOSIT"; "The deposit stage recorded by this tool is always the initial deposit"). P1 = initial deposit payment.
- Hop P0←P2 (state-derived): §5 "The pre-service balance is not fixed until the booking shows a retained late-change fee entry for its late patient move, where it has one" + records establish a late patient move (item 4B) and no fee entry. The write recording "one retained-fee entry on the booking": late-change fee doc. P2 = keep the late-change fee.
- Hop P2←P1 (state-derived): late-change fee doc "The late-change fee is retained only once an initial deposit collection stands on the surgery booking."
- Order: P1 → P2 → P0. P1 has no visible prerequisite.
- Counter-proof "do only what was asked": paying only a balance leaves §5's state unmet (no initial collection, no fee entry) so no fixed balance exists; paying only the initial deposit leaves the booking short of what the customer asked to settle and leaves the move's fee unkept; skipping the fee changes deposits held and so the balance figure. Excluded by visible sentences + records, no route statement used.
- Closest alternatives excluded: points added before the days-to-surgery replacement (75) — excluded by "takes the place of the package's deposit percentage and is the booking's deposit percentage" + points "added to the booking's deposit percentage"; the fee under the package cancellation clause (lesser of 150.00 and deposits) — excluded by "The fee kept on a late patient move … is not settled by this clause"; fee basis 150.00 — excluded by the scale doc; FAP-reduced base for the early/pay-in-full credits — excluded by "figured on the surgical package price — the facility line plus the professional line"; implant line in the package price — excluded by Clause 3.

Pre-solved hops: none observed. Note for Step 3b: the two prerequisite sentences and the full late-patient-move definition sit in the computation document (§5), not the payment card; §4's assembly sentence ("the price owed before surgery comes first … any amount added to or taken off the balance is figured on its own") and Clause 4's "any percentage points added to it included" / Term 5's "each share of the fee basis kept for the move multiplies it" announce that variations exist — I did not need them to find any factor (records led to each), but they are judged in policy_kb.
